biotools.summary: ESPClust is a software tool for unsupervised identification of covariates that modify the effect size profile in omics association studies. It analyzes effect size profiles to identify subpopulations with distinct associations, offering a novel approach to understanding complex omics data and potentially enabling personalized medicine.
